Hi Sophie —

Quick heads up: we just heard that FintechX is looping in security and procurement for the upcoming platform walkthrough. Given that, we should expand the session and align on a slot that works for the extended panel. Security specifically asked for a 20–30 minute technical touchpoint, and procurement wants ~20 minutes to go over contracting/SLAs.

Because of the extra requests, I recommend we move from a standard 45-minute demo to an 110-minute block (60 product + 30 security + 20 procurement). I attached a short checklist that helps us make the most of the panel.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Dec 8: 10:00–11:50 or 13:00–14:50
- Wed Dec 9: 13:00–14:50

If those don't work, tell me the stakeholders' hard constraints and we will accommodate. Once we lock time, I will send an updated agenda and calendar invite.

Attachments: StakeholderChecklist.pdf

Thanks —

Agree with Naomi's structure, but two asks from our side to make the session efficient:
1) Security asked for a 30-minute pre-demo deep dive focusing on network isolation, KMS/HSM integration, and audit logs. Ideally that happens immediately before the product walkthrough (so security can flag anything technical).
2) Procurement wants a 20-minute follow-up to cover pricing cadence, data retention, and contract milestones.

If we stack those together we should budget ~110 minutes total. Practical scheduling preference from engineering/security: Mon Dec 13 at 11:00 PT works best (Dev and I are both available).
